digest.component_or_area: review-bot test harness and lifespan configuration
propositions: Entering the review-bot ASGI lifespan in a test inherits the production 1200-second shutdown queue-drain default, causing unit tests to hang or run long-running background work unintentionally.

The test harness must globally bound SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1.0 for all tests and stub the reconciler and janitor by default, while allowing opt-in to the real production reconcile_loop via a marker.
TestClient against the real application lifespan without per-test stubs must complete promptly with the exact 1.0-second test drain and no background reconciler or janitor execution.
Test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS overrides (e.g., 0.1) must take precedence over the suite-wide 1.0 baseline.
Production DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS must remain exactly 1200 seconds and unmodified.
